## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`sys_webhook` 对象说明、`managed_by` 与 `customized` 两个字段的帮助文字改写为现行模型：数据行是组织在 Studio 或 API 中编写的订阅；代码中声明的 webhook 从元数据注册表读取，不写入任何行。英文翻译由生成器重写，zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES 三条译文同步重译。
- 为什么改：旧文字仍说声明的 webhook「启动时物化为数据行」，而 ADR-0131 D2 已退役该启动种入器，Setup/Studio 用户读到的是错误说明。
- 风险与回滚：仅文字，无行为、字段或选项变化；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/sys-webhook.object.ts`（对象 description 与两个字段 description）、`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/translations/zh-CN.objects.generated.ts`（重译三条）、`.changeset/27607-sys-webhook-text.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --filter=webhooks`（需先 build CLI），预期 `in sync`；`git grep -n "materialized into rows on boot"` 在源码与翻译中零命中。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `sys_webhook.description`: a row is an outbound subscription an organization authors in the Studio editor or through the API; a webhook declared with `defineStack({ webhooks })` / `defineWebhook()` is read from the metadata registry and writes no row here (ADR-0131 D2, anchored in a code comment beside the text). The file's top docblock was already correct and is unchanged.
- `managed_by` field description: `admin` = created in Setup or through the API; `package` = a copy the retired 18.0 boot seeder wrote, which nothing writes now; `platform` = reserved. The enum values are unchanged. Measured: no writer sets `managed_by: 'package'` or `'platform'` on a `sys_webhook` row on this tree (the seeder `bootstrapDeclaredWebhooks` is retired; `isSeededProvenance` only reads the values).
- `customized` field description (bounded in-place fix, same file, same defect class): it said "boot seeding will no longer overwrite the row", the same retired model. It now says the ownership ceremony reads it (an edited copy under a declared name is kept as a clone, a pristine one deleted), matching `webhook-provenance.ts`.
- Translations: `en.objects.generated.ts` regenerated by `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write --filter=webhooks` (no other package's bundle was written). The generator's merge keeps an existing translated value even when its source changes, so the zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES strings for these three texts were re-translated by hand (AGENTS.md allows editing translated-locale values; no key added or dropped), then the generator was re-run and kept them. No source-hash entry covers these leaves.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/plugin-webhooks` patch.
